name: web-blue-gradient-subscription-landing-on-tilted-monitor-with-social-posts
title: Blue Subscription Landing on Tilted Monitor with Social Posts
whatItIs: A white board with a large tilted monitor on black pedestals showing a sky-blue gradient landing page with a serif headline, floating white UI cards and a Download Now pill, above two Instagram post mockups: a white one 'Send or receive money instantly' with a woman making an OK sign and a blue quote card.
whatItMeans: A steep tilt and blue gradient make the site feel airy and dynamic, and the posts prove the system on social.
techniques: Steeply tilted monitor on angular black bases
Italic serif line in a sans headline
Floating white cards on a gradient hero
Instagram post frames as a second row
Blue gradient used in both web and social

vocabulary.definition: A desktop screen rotated in perspective.
A social post shown inside platform chrome.
A UI card set over a gradient at an angle.
